en: What did you do today?
What did you eat today?

sk: S kým si sa dnes rozprával?
en: Who did you talk to today?

sk: Aké nové slovo si sa naučil?
en: What new word did you learn?
What was the weather like today?
What are you going to do tomorrow?
How do you feel today?

es: ¿Qué fue lo mejor de tu día?
sk: Čo bolo na tvojom dni najlepšie?
en: What was the best part of your day?
Where did you go today?
What did you buy this week?
What time did you get up?

es: ¿Qué hiciste en el trabajo o en la escuela?
sk: Čo si robil v práci alebo v škole?
en: What did you do at work or at school?

es: ¿Qué te gustaría hacer este fin de semana?
sk: Čo by si chcel robiť cez víkend?
en: What would you like to do this weekend?
What music did you listen to today?

es: Describe tu casa o tu departamento.
en: Describe your house or your apartment.
What did you cook this week?

es: Habla de un amigo o una amiga.
sk: Napíš niečo o kamarátovi alebo kamarátke.
en: Write about a friend.

es: ¿Qué hiciste el fin de semana pasado?
en: What did you do last weekend?

es: ¿Cuál es tu plan para esta semana?
sk: Aký máš plán na tento týždeň?
en: What is your plan for this week?

sk: Čo si dnes videl na ulici?
en: What did you see in the street today?
What was hard for you today?

sk: Aký film alebo seriál si nedávno videl?
en: What film or series have you watched lately?

es: Describe a alguien de tu familia.
en: Describe someone in your family.
What are you wearing today?
Did you exercise today?

es: ¿Qué lugar te gustaría visitar y por qué?
sk: Aké miesto by si chcel navštíviť a prečo?
en: What place would you like to visit, and why?
What did you do in the evening?

es: ¿Qué fue lo más difícil de tu semana?
sk: Čo bolo na tvojom týždni najťažšie?
en: What was the hardest part of your week?
What made you laugh today?

es: Escribe tres cosas que aprendiste en español.
sk: Napíš tri veci, ktoré si sa naučil po španielsky.
en: Write three things you learned in Spanish.
